title: Black Sea Disruption Could Push Food Prices Higher | Presented by CME Group
description:
Wheat prices are near three-year highs as Russian exports run at less than half last year’s pace and Ukrainian shipping lanes remain under threat. With global food prices at their highest since late 2022, could further Black Sea disruption drive up the cost of bread, cereal and other everyday staples? Presented by @cmegroup
